## State and callback contract

The screen is controlled through `DashboardOverviewScreenProps`. User intent crosses the application boundary through `onCreateInvoice`, `onPrimaryAction`, `onTransactionPress`, `onViewActivity`; fetching, routing, persistence and side effects remain application-owned.

```tsx
export type DashboardOverviewScreenProps = {
  data?: DashboardOverviewData;
  onCreateInvoice?: () => void;
  onPrimaryAction?: () => void;
  onTransactionPress?: (transaction: TransactionRowData) => void;
  onViewActivity?: () => void;
  state?: 'ready' | 'loading' | 'empty';
};
```

Common product states such as loading, success, empty, error, permission-like recovery, filtering/search/selection or pagination are represented only where the actual screen source exposes them. The pattern docs do not invent backend states that the fixture does not render.

## Application ownership boundary

**Intentionally excluded:** Data fetching, invoice creation, and navigation.

BeeUI does not take ownership of app routing, authentication/business rules, APIs/data fetching, persistence, form/state frameworks, chart frameworks or backend logic merely because a pattern visually composes those product concepts.

## Source ownership

`DashboardOverviewScreen` is **Showcase source you copy**, not a package export: it is not shipped from any `@beemvp/beeui-*` package, and the Registry CLI (`pnpm beeui list` / `pnpm beeui add`) does not carry pattern screens. Copy [`apps/showcase/patterns/dashboard-finance/screens/dashboard-overview-screen.tsx`](https://github.com/beobungbu/BeeUI/blob/main/apps/showcase/patterns/dashboard-finance/screens/dashboard-overview-screen.tsx) into your app and adapt it directly.
